entity1.name: Dinosaurs
entity1.description: A group of reptiles that lived in the Mesozoic Era and are now extinct.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are a significant subject in both popular culture and scientific study.;;;A group of reptiles that lived in the Mesozoic Era, known for their diverse species and large sizes.;;;Refers to large beings or animals that are imagined or theorized to have existed in the past.;;;A group of prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are known for their large size and diversity.;;;A group of reptiles that lived in the past and are known for their diverse adaptations and physical features.;;;Extinct reptiles that lived millions of years ago during the Mesozoic Era.;;;A group of reptiles that lived in the past and are now extinct, known for their diverse species and significant presence in prehistoric times.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are studied to understand ancient ecosystems and evolutionary processes.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are now extinct.;;;A group of reptiles that were dominant during the Mesozoic Era and became extinct approximately 65 million years ago.;;;A group of reptiles that lived during the Mesozoic Era and became extinct approximately 65 million years ago.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are a popular subject in scientific study and cultural media.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that are a popular subject in modern culture.;;;Prehistoric reptiles that lived millions of years ago and are a subject of scientific study and public fascination.
